what_this_is: the shared Experiment 2 candidate universe. Both treatments -- route-level and path-level decision representation -- optimize over exactly this set, so neither can gain from a better pool.
rule: Model A shortlist UNION D16 bound-only entrants, then widened to every splice. Adding a candidate is the preferred error: a candidate is never dropped for ranking poorly under Model A when the lower-bound screen calls it plausibly competitive.
why_all_splices: D16 amendment. The bracket's aggregate Spearman of 0.857 is carried by BETWEEN-kind separation; within splices -- the only kind taking a top-ten slot at either endpoint -- it is 0.336. The set {splices are the good kind} is robust; the ordering inside it is not, and a top-eight shortlist is exactly an ordering.

excluded_kinds.reason: none takes a top-ten slot at either endpoint of the bracket; within-kind Spearman 0.64-0.99, so the bracket agrees they rank low. Documented as a limitation: they were never evaluated, not shown to be worthless.

screen_status: non-authoritative triage. The screen holds frequency fixed and cannot express Model B (its multiplier is a property of a leg; the screen prices from RAPTOR labels before the alighting stop is known), so no Experiment 2 conclusion rests on a screen score. See D19: the screen's first-ranked candidate of sixty is second-worst of twelve on evaluation.
